approach: Evaluation-only additive rescue: consider only the independently ranked E5 primary-index winner, append at most one absent record to unused MiniLM slots. Preserve all original records, claims, positions and complete delivery. No replacing, reordering or changing defaults.
features: Only unconditioned eligible primary-index top three: model cosine, top-one minus top-two margin, optional membership in MiniLM top three. Required/expected identities and answerability are never inputs to admission.
selection: Use original/fresh/new development only. First screen all 220 policies for possible complete-answer gains and zero changed negative returned identities. This screen is an optimistic upper bound on full-packet delivery, not native packet evaluation. Any potential survivor requires actual native packet rendering, the unchanged per-record comparator, historical development, then heldout evaluation before production consideration. Never use oracle labels for admission or retune queries after scoring.
fallback: If no safe potential gain, reject the additive family without scoring heldout or adding a second production model. Record missed-gold ranks and stronger negative-margin counterexamples. No production model, download/release, schema or threshold change.
